title: When Opposites Become Causes: An Indexed Cross-Domain Framework for Oppositional Causal Inversion
domain: metascience / causal inference / psychology / economics / organization science / international relations / information science / complex systems
summary: A falsification-first indexed framework for a restricted class of opposite-producing causal effects. It requires a prespecified functional opposite and explicit actor, level, time, construct, environment, feedback, or capacity indices. Pilot 0A and reproducible dual-source retrieval are complete; independent Coder B construct validation remains the decisive hard gate.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design with live prior-art audit and falsification-first framing
